title: Grapheme-to-Phoneme (G2P)
description: Architected a high-precision phonetic transcription engine for speech synthesis pipelines by benchmarking custom sequence-to-sequence models against parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT/LoRA) techniques.
shortDescription: High-precision neural G2P engine for speech synthesis pipelines
highlights: Designed a two-stage curriculum strategy: pre-trained a Seq2Seq Transformer on a massive synthetic corpus re-labeled via teacher-model distillation, then fine-tuned on high-quality pronunciation data.
Significantly outperformed single-stage blended training, achieving higher phonetic accuracy and generalization on complex out-of-vocabulary tokens.
